transitions.action: create RTSP session context, store parameters and state, create session identifier, include Session header in response, select transport alternative, include Transport header in response
server creates RTSP session and returns session identifier

transitions.event: SETUP request referencing new media resource
transitions.action: add media resource under common control with existing resources

transitions.event: client fails to show liveness for more than session timeout value
client sends TEARDOWN request referencing aggregated control URI
all media resources removed from session context
server sends TEARDOWN request indicating reason

transitions.action: Start sending data via the mechanism specified in SETUP; position normal play time to the beginning of the range specified in the Range header
Replace the current PLAY action with the new one requested; continue to play from where it currently was until the specified endpoint if the range has an implicit start time

transitions.event: PLAY request without Range header when media delivery has stopped at the end
transitions.action: Respond with 457 (Invalid Range) error response including current pause point in a Range header

transitions.event: PLAY request with explicit start value in Range header
transitions.action: Stop playout at current point, start delivering media according to new Range header, respond with 200 OK

transitions.event: PLAY request with implicit start and explicit stop value in Range header
transitions.action: Update current range stop point to new value, continue playout, respond with 200 OK

transitions.event: PLAY request with implicit start and explicit stop value in Range header where current delivery point is beyond stop point
transitions.action: Immediately pause delivery, set pause point to requested stop point, respond with 200 OK, send PLAY_NOTIFY with end-of-stream

transitions.event: PLAY request with Range header 'npt=now-' and Scale header
transitions.action: Update playback scale, respond with 200 OK including actual playback point in Range header

transitions.event: TEARDOWN (aggregated control URI or media URI in non-aggregated session)
transitions.action: halt media delivery, destroy session state, response without Session header

transitions.event: TEARDOWN (aggregated control URI or media URI in non-aggregated session)
transitions.action: halt media delivery, destroy session state, response without Session header
remove indicated media stream and associated resources, response with Session header
send TEARDOWN request; MAY reestablish the session using the resource indicated by the Location

transitions.event: request with method not valid in this state
transitions.action: 455 Method Not Valid in This State response with Allow header
media begins to flow from server to client over the RTP TCP connection, and RTCP packets flow bidirectionally over the RTCP TCP connection
pauses the flow of packets over the connections, without closing the connections
signals that the TCP connections for RTP and RTCP are to be closed by the RTSP client as soon as possible
respond using the 464 (Data Transport Not Ready Yet) error code
takes effect immediately replacing the previous request
